title: When Asa Forgot to Trust
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight King Asa forgets to pause and ask God first: Wren tries to fix a swim-lesson worry with a secret deal, then stops, tells the truth, and prays.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Wren likes to stop and think things through, and tonight a good king forgets to stop and ask God first. In Wren’s world today: Wren has a wobbly, worried tummy about the first swim lesson. Wren hides the goggles under the bed. Then Wren makes a deal with big sister to trade a sticker if she tells Mom that Wren feels sick. That night, Wren pauses and ponders and feels sorry. Wren tells Mom the truth, and they kneel and ask God for help to be brave. In the morning the worry is smaller. Just like King Asa, Wren learned that God is ready to help with big things and small things, and that we can always turn back and ask Him first.
